verdict.rationale: Recruitee supports Bearer-token API credentials, and there's a distinct 'Careers API token' type that is scoped to only public career-site endpoints (offers, candidates apply), showing some least-privilege separation between admin and public tokens; role-based ability gating exists for webhooks. However there's no evidence of granular per-agent scopes, expiring/short-lived tokens, or fine-grained read/write permission selection for the main API tokens used by an 'agent'. Missing for 10: documented scope/permission selection UI for main API tokens, token expiration/rotation controls, per-agent identity or audit trail tied to token, independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement beyond the Careers API subset.
